text: Use Aimparency as the strategy and intent agent for external autonomous runtimes
description: Aimparency preserves human-governed intent, explains priority context, proposes bounded delegations to independently operated specialist agents, and reconciles returned evidence. MCP remains the local graph-tool boundary; A2A is the peer-agent interoperability boundary. The architecture is specified in meta/a2a-strategy-agent-boundary.md. Implementation is activated only by a qualified customer workflow or a credible deployer agreeing to a concrete exchange, so protocol work does not displace economic validation.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Smallest protocol-compliant exposure of the strategy-agent architecture.

status.comment: A2A boundary specified (meta/a2a-strategy-agent-boundary.md). Implementation waits on a real interoperability case: a customer workflow or deployer agreeing to a concrete exchange.
